translation: shuroo Allah kay naam say jo sabb per meharban hai , boht meharban hai
beyshak hum ney iss ( Quran ) ko shabb-e-qadar mein nazil kiya hai .
aur tumhen kiya maloom kay shabb-e-qadar kiya cheez hai-?
shabb-e-qadar aik hazar maheenon say bhi behtar hai .
uss mein farishtay aur rooh apney perwerdigar ki ijazat say her kaam kay liye utartey hain ,
woh raat sarapa salamti hai fajar kay tuloo honey tak .
